D5/S3/Observer/Reversal/QuadraticObserva.name: D5.S3.Observer.Reversal.QuadraticObservationClosure.observed_increment
D5/S3/Observer/Reversal/QuadraticObserva.signature: theorem observed_increment (P L : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (B : E →ₗ[ℝ] E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (a b : E) : P (vectorField L B (a + b)) - P (vectorField L B a) = P (L b) - P (B a b + B b a) - P (B b b)

D5/S3/Observer/Reversal/QuadraticObserva.name: D5.S3.Observer.Reversal.QuadraticObservationClosure.quadratic_closure_iff
D5/S3/Observer/Reversal/QuadraticObserva.signature: theorem quadratic_closure_iff (P L : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (B : E →ₗ[ℝ] E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (hP : ∀ x, P (P x) = P x) : (∃ f : E → E, ∀ x, P (vectorField L B x) = f (P x)) ↔ (∀ b, P b = 0 → P (L b) = 0) ∧ (∀ b, P b = 0 → P (B b b) = 0) ∧ (∀ a b, P a = a → P b = 0 → P (B a b + B b a) = 0)
